info.title: SYNTHORA Translate — any language, auto-detect
info.description: Translate any text between 100+ languages with automatic source-language detection. Preserves tone, formatting and placeholders. JSON in/out, Ed25519-signed. Pay-per-use via x402 USDC on Base — $0.001 per call, 10x cheaper than alternatives.
info.x-guidance: POST /service with {"text":"Hello","target":"es"} (source optional, auto-detected). Returns {detected, translation, target}.
x-use-cases: detect the language of a text and translate it
translate user messages in a chat app
give an autonomous agent cheap translation
